title: RB=F log-return z>1 shorts JETS/SPY 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] RB=F gasoline daily log returns 20d z-score > 1 lead JETS/SPY ratio lower by 1-3 days (-); stationary-returns control of R2-0077 whose level rule fit pre-war (hit 56%) but lost out-of-sample in the war test; trade short JETS vs SPY 3d [finance.RB=F.log_return -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0077)
message: Not tradeable: RB=F log-return z>1 short JETS/SPY fit pre-war (31 trades, hit 55%, +0.25%/trade) but lost in war test (17 trades, hit 53%, -0.18%/trade, excess -0.23%); relationship is coincident (lag0 r=-0.34, n=389), no lead at lags 1-3; actionability 4.21

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.RB=F.log_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short ratio:jets_spy next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] RB=F gasoline daily log-return 20d z-score > 1 is followed by JETS/SPY ratio mean-reverting higher over 2-5 days (+); reversal control of R2-0177 where the coincident r=-0.34 vanished at positive lags (|r|<0.08) and the 1d short lost out-of-sample (war hit 53%, -0.18%/trade); trade long JETS vs SPY 3d [finance.RB=F.log_return -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0177)
